checks_format: 每条 check 是一个字符串 '<verb>: <arg>'，可程序判定。正则一律大小写不敏感，只用 Python re 与 JS 通用的子集（允许前瞻 (?!...)，不用回顾断言）。verb 含义：text / no_text 作用于整段 transcript（助手可见文字加已执行命令）；answer / no_answer 只作用于最终回复；cmd / no_cmd 只作用于已执行的 shell 命令（含 heredoc 正文）；bg / no_bg 要求匹配的命令是否以后台方式启动；order: A => B 表示 A、B 都在已执行命令中出现且 A 首次匹配早于 B；count: <regex> <= N 表示匹配的已执行命令条数不超过 N；files: <glob> >= N、filecontains: <glob> => <regex> 与 nofilecontains: <glob> => <regex> 检查运行结束后工作目录里的文件（后两者对每个匹配文件都要满足）；len: answer <= N 限制最终回复字符数。difficulty 为 hard 的题需要同时满足多条约束或抵住诱导，其余为 standard。

evals.prompt: 在后台让 Codex 审查这个仓库最近一次提交里的鉴权改动，不要改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Launch a read-only Codex review as a background shell with gpt-6-sol at medium effort, disclose the sandbox in one line, do not poll, and report findings with file references when the completion notice arrives.

evals.prompt: 让一个 Codex 改 src/lib/session.ts 里的过期逻辑，改完再让另一个 Codex 审查同一个文件。
evals.expected_output: Sequence writer and reviewer for overlapping paths; collect writer result before review, then synthesize findings.

evals.prompt: 让 Codex 用 gpt-6-terra 分析一下 cache 层为什么偶发返回旧数据，先别改文件。
evals.expected_output: Use the user-specified model and read-only sandbox, run as background worker, then report results without editing.

evals.prompt: 后台那个 codex 任务（tag codex-review）退出码是 1，尾部输出只有一行 error: stream disconnected before completion。帮我查原因并继续。
evals.expected_output: Inspect captured error, run codex doctor or relevant diagnostic, adjust cause before retrying; report unresolved failure precisely.

evals.prompt: 用 Codex 给官网生一张透明背景的吉祥物图。
evals.expected_output: Route image request to imagegen skill and its image acceptance flow, not the code-agent workflow.

evals.prompt: auth 和 billing 两个模块各让一个 Codex 同时改，但它们都得动 src/lib/session.ts。
evals.expected_output: Never run two write-capable workers on the same file at once: either serialize them, assign disjoint files, or give each its own git worktree, then merge findings and surface any disagreement.

evals.prompt: 昨天那个 codex 会话里还差最后两个用例没跑完，接着做，别换模型，权限也保持原样。
evals.expected_output: Resume the previous session with the last-session resume form; put no further flags on resume, since model, effort and sandbox are inherited; run it in the background.

evals.prompt: 让 Codex 审查这次 diff，结果我要拿脚本解析：每条问题带 file、line、severity 三个字段。
evals.expected_output: Constrain the final response with an output schema and write the last message to a file instead of scraping stdout.

evals.prompt: 给我一个跨模块的支付层重构方案，让 Codex 只读地分析现有调用关系，方案我自己来定。
evals.expected_output: Run a read-only worker at the default medium effort; do not raise reasoning effort on its own for an architecture task, and do not edit files.

evals.prompt: Codex 已经把 PR 的改动写完了，你再找个 Claude 子 agent 来复核一下。
evals.expected_output: Keep maker and checker separate but use another read-only gpt-6-sol reviewer against the diff (fleet code --review or codex review), not a Claude subagent.
